analysis_notes.assessment_of_unassigned_nodes: All unassigned dataset nodes appear exclusively in eitza (cause-and-effect) edges for Torah #8. None of them are connected by a bechina edge and therefore correctly have no package assignment. They represent outcomes/results in the teaching's causal chain.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The teaching opens by identifying נשימה as the bechina of רוח חיים ('כי על ידי בחינת הנשימה שהוא הרוח חיים נברא העולם'). The node נשימה does not appear as a node in any bechina edge for Torah #8 in the dataset. It is the foundational premise of the entire Torah.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept: צדיק / הצדיק שבדור (the Tzaddik of the generation)
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The Tzaddik is described explicitly as בחינת 'איש אשר רוח בו' (Numbers 27:18). This bechina identification appears in the source text but is encoded in the dataset only as an eitza (קישור לצדיק → drawing of ruach-chaim), not as a bechina edge for Torah #8.

The text states 'צפון חסר' — the north direction is bechina of lack/deficiency, since the heart's longing is located there. This bechina relationship is explained in the text but does not appear as a bechina edge in the Torah #8 dataset.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept: ארבעה יסודות (Four elements: fire, wind, water, earth)
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The Torah describes the four elements as the bechina of the four letters of the Divine Name (YHWH). The text contains explicit בחינת language: 'ארבע אותיות הוי"ה... והם ארבעה יסודות'. This does not appear as a bechina edge for Torah #8 in the dataset.

The Torah is delivered as an interpretation of 'ראיתי והנה מנורת זהב' (Zechariah 4). The menorah/its branches appear to map onto the teaching structure but do not appear as bechina node pairs in the Torah #8 dataset.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept: גן (the garden = Torah) explicit pairing with Torah
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The text from Tikkunei Zohar is cited: 'גן – דא אורייתא'. This gnostic identification of the garden with Torah underpins the whole §7 analogy. The node 'גן' does not appear as a bechina-edge node for Torah #8.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept: ישראל ← עניה סוערה (Israel currently under Esav's storm-wind)
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The text identifies Israel under exile as 'עניה סוערה' (Isaiah 54:11), i.e. bechina of one buffeted by Esav's storm-wind. This bechina identification does not appear as an explicit bechina edge for Torah #8.
